title-group.article-title: Synthetic review of zeta-kinase signalling in breast tumours

article-meta.aff: Institute of Examples, Example City, Germany

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Zeta-kinase is a fictional enzyme1. It was described twice 2, 3. Later work disagreed (4–7).

sec.title: Mechanisms
sec.p: A range given as text 8–10 supports the model. Another sentence cites the first source again 1.

sec.title: Clinical evidence
sec.p: Trial results were mixed 1. A fourth mention of the first source 1. “Quoted claim” with an en dash – here 12.
